newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa committed to phased fx easing - finance DG.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa committed to phased fx easing - finance DG.

text.p: The South African government remains committed to the phased lifting of foreign exchange controls on residents, finance department director-general Maria Ramos said on Wednesday.
"There is no change in policy at all." she told the Cape Town Press Club.

"We've committed ourselves to lifting exchange controls. We've also committed ourselves to doing it gradually, to doing it carefully, to take into consideration other aspects of our economy and to ensure that the liberalisation of our capital account fits in with our overall strategy.
"It's not an event, it's a process."
